card-row.looks: A grid of navy cards, each with a logo or small image at the top, a short paragraph and an outline 'Learn more' button. A vertical variant makes taller cards with a title, four per row.
card-row.use: Programmes or partner sites that each have their own logo.
card-row.avoid: No logos: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid (info-cards-grid).

fields.variant: horizontal (default): larger cards, three per row, no title. vertical: taller cards with a title, four per row.
fields.columns: Optional cards per row, 1 to 6; empty keeps 3 (horizontal) or 4 (vertical).

fields.logo: A logo or emblem; the card is built around it.
fields.title: Shown only with variant vertical.
fields.buttonText: The button's words, e.g. 'Learn more', with buttonLink.
